basic_info.description: Fully detached, sun-drenched two-story Victorian home with a private entrance and modern upgrades. Tucked quietly off the street and accessed via a charming breezeway, this home has been meticulously redesigned, blending historic character with the comforts of today. With nearly 1400 sq ft of light-filled living space, features include soaring ceilings, oak floors and original details. The open layout connects spacious living and dining areas with a beautifully remodeled kitchen showcasing walnut cabinetry, stone countertops, high-end appliances, custom tile-work and island seating. West-facing windows open to a redwood deck overlooking bougainvillea, trumpet flowers, and banana treescreating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Upstairs offers three generous bedrooms, including a sunlit primary with walk-in closet and serene outlooks. The renovated full bath offers spa-like finishes with heated floors and designer fixtures + whimsical modern design in main level powder room. The home includes central heat, dedicated laundry and storage and an owned solar system. A peaceful retreat steps from Duboce and Buena Vista Parks, cafs, restaurants, and transit. 309D Steiner Street is where Victorian charm meets contemporary living - offering a lifestyle as inviting as the home itself.
